heading: Liji 39 · Da Xue 大學 · The Great Learning · Da Xue 30 … Da Xue 39
Liji 39 · Da Xue 大學 · The Great Learning · Da Xue 1 … Da Xue 15

items.text: Rest in filial piety toward your father.
items.quote: As a son, he rested in filial piety.

items.text: Rest in kindness toward your children.
items.quote: As a father, he rested in kindness.

heading: Liji 39 · Da Xue 大學 · The Great Learning · Da Xue 16 … Da Xue 29

items.text: Order your household rightly, and your household will attest your rule.
items.quote: This bride to her new home repairs; Her household will attest her rule.

items.text: Dwell in concord with your brothers.
items.quote: In concord with their brothers may they dwell!

items.text: Be a model for your children as a father.
items.quote: When the ruler as a father, a son, an elder brother or a younger, is a model for imitation

items.text: Be a model as a son before your parents.
items.quote: When the ruler as a father, a son, an elder brother or a younger, is a model for imitation

items.text: Be a model as an elder brother to your younger siblings.
items.quote: When the ruler as a father, a son, an elder brother or a younger, is a model for imitation

items.text: Be a model as a younger brother to your elder siblings.
items.quote: When the ruler as a father, a son, an elder brother or a younger, is a model for imitation

items.text: Treat your aged parents as they ought to be treated.
items.quote: When the superiors behave to their aged as the aged should be behaved to

items.text: Behave toward elders with brotherly submission.
items.quote: when they behave to their elders as elders should be behaved to, the people learn brotherly submission

items.text: Treat the young and helpless compassionately.
items.quote: when they treat compassionately the young and helpless, the people do the same

items.text: Do not do to those below you what you dislike from those above you.
items.quote: What a man dislikes in his superiors, let him not display in his treatment of his inferiors

items.text: Do not do to those above you what you dislike from those below you.
items.quote: what he dislikes in his inferiors, let him not display in his service of his superiors

items.text: Count as precious the affection you owe even to your deceased parent.
items.quote: What he should consider precious is the affection due (even) to his (deceased) parent.
